# Getting help

- **How do I...?** Ask in [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/dassjaylabs/filmwright/discussions/categories/q-a).
  Include your `reel.yaml` and the output of `filmwright doctor`.
- **Something is broken:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/dassjaylabs/filmwright/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **An idea:** start in [Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/dassjaylabs/filmwright/discussions/categories/ideas), or open a
  [feature request](https://github.com/dassjaylabs/filmwright/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) if it's concrete.
- **A security problem:** report it [privately](https://github.com/dassjaylabs/filmwright/security/advisories/new).

filmwright is maintained in spare time. Replies usually come within a week; please don't ping individuals.
